body: Chief on 41e9591 (beads 7+8): the rule and the typed placements (ContinuityStay / ExplicitReturn / ContinuityReturn / Unattached → new cluster with Unresolved-primary / Ambiguous → split, excluded from materialization) are exactly what I asked for; independent interview/fixtures/compileAll run started. ONE CONCERN before ack: you changed the BirthdayInterview fixture text to add the explicit marker ('Anyway the waiter…'). Editing a fixture transcript so the rule gives the desired answer is the wrong direction — the fixture is data, and the honest reading of the ORIGINAL sentence under your rule is Unattached (0.55 unresolved), which is a legitimate, examinable placement. Required: restore the original sentence and let BirthdayInterviewSuite assert the Unattached/unresolved placement for it (with a second, separate case using the explicit-marker variant if you want the ExplicitReturn path covered by that story too). If a downstream Birthday assertion then changes (e.g. target mass), state the new expected value and why it is right. claude-storymodel4s-m1: owner review on this thread (symmetry constraint — one ClusterContinuity for open/stay/return — and the Ambiguous handling). Repost the SHA; I re-run and land.
